methodology.long_investment: Match live ETF histories vs VOO 2019+ and 2022+, including dividends embedded in adjusted prices and estimated 10bps monthly buy costs. Filter by recent momentum/trend.
methodology.short_stock_watch: Show 30 surviving companies with positive 63/126-day momentum above SMA200, no claim of predictive stock alpha.
methodology.trade_entry: After a completed US close breaks above the PRIOR 20-session high, 200-day SMA, positive 63 and 126-session returns; next US regular opening is paper fill.
methodology.trade_exit: Next session open after a close crosses 7% downside from entry, previous 10-session low, 200-day SMA or after 15 holding sessions.
methodology.trading_backtest: Nonoverlapping trades since 2018, same-date VOO entry/exit, estimated 10bps costs on both sides; bootstrap historical matched excess.
methodology.trade_gate: At least 30 total completed trades, 10 in 2022+, positive average matched excess in entire and recent periods, positive lower bound of descriptive 90% bootstrap; STILL not approved to trade live until prospective data independent of selection.
methodology.execution_time: Signal after US market close, proposed buy the NEXT open; never pretend an entry is available in the already-closed session.
methodology.long_horizon: Long term 1–5+ years, no fixed successful sell date. Use periodic review, not short-term trading stops.
methodology.live_prices: Not provided: GitHub Pages is a daily research snapshot, not a live brokerage terminal.

data_limits: The trade backtest covers a finite handpicked ETF list and 30 present-day stock survivors; stock backtests have survivorship bias and multiple ticker searches inflate chance of apparent winners.
All trade strategies remain research-only even if historical screening passes.
Simulated next-open trading may not match accessible broker quotes, fills, order sizes or FX costs.
Trading stop checks closes only; overnight gaps can exceed the planned loss limit.
U.S. exchange holidays are not represented by simple business-day estimates.
XMMO index methodology was changed in June 2019; older XMMO history under prior index is not evidence for the present method.
US ETF after-tax results may differ materially from Ireland-domiciled CSPX for Singapore-based investors.
This site is refreshed by scheduled GitHub Actions; it has no real-time data subscription and cannot guarantee notification delivery.

The current US-listed stock universe excludes previously delisted companies; historical results can be biased.
A large one-year price gain may reverse, so it is not automatically a good purchase.
Comparing trailing one-year stock returns with VOO is NOT proof of future excess returns.
